title: Einblicke und Ausblicke: Perspektiven für die Bildungsforschung und -praxis = Sguardi e traguardi: prospettive per la ricerca e la pratica educativa
summary: The aim of this volume is to bring together scientifically acquired and experience-saturated insights about education and to stimulate a lively discourse between the various participants from educational research and practice. The aim is to work co-constructively on new forms of knowledge about education that reflexively interweave research findings and practical experience in order to generate innovative conceptual and theoretically sound ideas for education that is fit for the future. In this way, this volume provides a variety of insights into new approaches to general inclusive education and didactics as well as an outlook on further perspectives.
